### 💡 Intuition & Approach
The implementation solves **Top Tracks On Pulse Charts** directly following its mathematical and algorithmic specification.

### ⚡ Python Reference Implementation
```python
import pandas as pd

def ds1_pandas_top_tracks(streams: list, top_n: int = 3) -> list:
    df = pd.DataFrame(streams)
    agg = df.groupby(["genre", "track_id"], as_index=False)["play_count"].sum()
    agg = agg.sort_values(["genre", "play_count", "track_id"], ascending=[True, False, True])
    agg["rank"] = agg.groupby("genre").cumcount() + 1
    res = agg[agg["rank"] <= int(top_n)][["genre", "track_id", "play_count"]]
    return res.to_dict(orient="records")
```
